sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "creator" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (media_type IN ('novel', 'manga')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "unit_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("media_item_id", "order_index"), CHECK (unit_type IN ('chapter')), CHECK (order_index >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content_unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_units (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_opened_at" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("media_item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manga_pages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_units (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pixel_width" INTEGER NULL, "pixel_height" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("content_unit_id", "order_index"), CHECK (order_index >= 0), CHECK (mime_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')), CHECK (byte_length >= 0), CHECK (pixel_width IS NULL OR pixel_width > 0), CHECK (pixel_height IS NULL OR pixel_height > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_progress" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content_unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_units (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "fraction" REAL NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("media_item_id"), CHECK (fraction >= 0 AND fraction <= 1), CHECK (revision >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reader_preferences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "font_size" REAL NULL, "line_height" REAL NULL, "theme_key" TEXT NULL, "reading_mode" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (scope IN ('global', 'mediaItem')), CHECK ((scope = 'global' AND media_item_id IS NULL) OR (scope = 'mediaItem' AND media_item_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (reading_mode IS NULL OR reading_mode = 'vertical'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manga_reader_preferences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reading_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "page_turn_direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (reading_mode IN ('vertical', 'horizontal', 'doublePage')), CHECK (page_turn_direction IN ('leftToRight', 'rightToLeft')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_encoding" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (source_kind IN ('txtFile', 'epubFile', 'mangaDirectory', 'mangaArchive')), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'failed', 'missing')), CHECK (text_encoding IS NULL OR text_encoding IN ('utf8', 'utf16le', 'utf16be', 'gb18030')), CHECK (file_size >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_tag_assignments" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "media_item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_shelves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_shelf_items" ("shelf_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_shelves (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "media_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("shelf_id", "media_item_id"));
CREATE INDEX bookmarks_media_created_idx ON bookmarks (media_item_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX media_items_type_updated_idx ON media_items (media_type, updated_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reader_preferences_global_idx ON reader_preferences (scope) WHERE scope = 'global'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reader_preferences_media_idx ON reader_preferences (media_item_id) WHERE scope = 'mediaItem'
CREATE INDEX import_records_fingerprint_idx ON import_records (fingerprint)
CREATE INDEX media_tag_assignments_media_idx ON media_tag_assignments (media_item_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX custom_shelf_items_shelf_order_idx ON custom_shelf_items (shelf_id, order_index)
